senses.gloss: 1. य the 1st semivowel (corresponding to the vowels इ and ई, and having the sound of the English y, in Bengal usually pronounced j).
2. य m. (in prosody) a bacchic (˘ ¯ ¯), Piṅg.
3. य the actual base of the relative pronoun in declension [cf. य॑द् and Gk. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ].
4. य m. (in some senses fr. √ 1. या, only, L.) a goer or mover
2. या (ifc.) going, moving (see ऋण-, एव-, तुर-, देव-या).
